theorems.name: Submission.dmcbr_ci_dilation_calculus
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (a : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → (∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, ∃ X' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ ω ω' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ y : Euclid P, (ω' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) y = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (dilation a lam y)) → X' ω = lam⁻¹ ^ m * X ω')) ∧ (∀ X X' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), (∀ ω ω' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), (∀ y : Euclid P, (ω' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) y = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (dilation a lam y)) → X' ω = lam⁻¹ ^ (m + 1) * X ω') → ∀ ω ω' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ y : Euclid P, (ω' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) y = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (dilation a lam y)) → X'.boundary ω = lam⁻¹ ^ m * X.boundary ω') ∧ (∀ X X' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ ω ω' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ y : Euclid P, (ω' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) y = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (dilation a lam y)) → X' ω = lam⁻¹ ^ m * X ω') → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsIntegerMultiplicity X') ∧ (∀ (X X' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P m), (∀ ω ω' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ y : Euclid P, (ω' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) y = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (dilation a lam y)) → X' ω = lam⁻¹ ^ m * X ω') → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, X ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ∂μ) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, X' ω = ∫ y, ξ (a + lam • y) ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) y) ∂(ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ m) • Measure.map (dilation a lam) μ)) ∧ (∀ X X' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ ω ω' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ y : Euclid P, (ω' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) y = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (dilation a lam y)) → X' ω = lam⁻¹ ^ m * X ω') → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), X'.massOn (dilation a lam '' W) = ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ m) * X.massOn W) ∧ (∀ A : Set (Euclid P), μHE[m] (dilation a lam '' A) = ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ m) * μHE[m] A)
